note: Inverted-index engine with tokenizers, not a trigram or regex-over-source engine; code search needs custom tokenizers
Embeddable Rust full-text engine, version 0.27.0, MIT, rust-version 1.91
BM25 scoring, phrase and boolean query language, multithreaded indexing
ReloadPolicy (Manual or OnCommitWithDelay) controls when a reader sees a commit; no link to source document versions
Index is a set of immutable UUID segments; incremental indexing, deletes and merges are in the design
MmapDirectory loads by mmapping files so readers need little anonymous memory; cross-process use is by file sharing
